reviews.review:
If you're into action games and especially if you're a 40K fan as well, I'd say this one is a must play. It's a solid experience from start to finish, without any bloat or unnecessary moments. The gameplay elements are what make and carry this game throughout. Much like the Emperor's Angels of Death, the gameplay elements are not found wanting. 

"Space Marine" is a wonderful gorefest of a game. Brutal, grimdark, and a product of eternal war. It does honor and justice to the 40K universe. Every hit on the xeno filth from righteous chainsword (or other weapons) and every blessed bolter slug (or other projectiles) bursting their skull feels absolutely amazing. And the executions - *chef's kiss*.

When the Orks scream their "WAAAAGH" you can feel that in your soul and it fills you with vigor to carry forth the Emperor's Will against them. 

Surprisingly, even in 2023, this game's visuals look amazing to me, and the sound design is very on point. Voice acting is very good as well. The story, while nothing surprising, does is job nonetheless, and there are a few cool characters (the protagonist being of them). Captain Titus is a great representation of the "stoic hero". 

You also go through quite a few varied environments, despite the bleak darkness and dystopian nature of 40K. Around the mid point of the game, you get some new enemies too other than Orks, and there are 2 great boss fights as well. 

All in all, this game completely fulfills what it sets out to do. If anything, I'd have liked more cutscenes between the characters that build their relationship and plot points, but what's there works anyway.

There are also some very great set piece moments!

"Courage and Honor!"

Being a total newcomer to WH40k, I'm sure I missed about 3/4s of the fun. Still, that one quarter of being a big armored dude kicking ass on a third person action/shooter hybrid is good enough, I must say.
SO good, glad i got it before 2. Can't wait to crush it while i wait!

Definitely showing it's age, but still worth a play-through especially with 2 coming out soonish.

The single player offering is very short, but what there is is very enjoyable. Titus makes a great lead with fab VA. The weapons have a nice variety and the shooting and melee both felt great to me.

The single player portion is pretty short as well, taking maybe 6-7 hours to do. So doesn't require much investment.

definitely recommend. however the FULL PRICE for a game this old and little content is absolutely ridiculous. especially with the sequel on the horizon which will probably be $10 more than this 12 year old game. wait for it to be $15 before buying.
